page-heading.purpose: The single h1 that identifies a product screen.

section-heading.purpose: A muted, compact h2 for meaningful screen subdivisions.

supporting.purpose: Secondary guidance below headings or primary content.

metadata.purpose: Timestamps, counts, identifiers, and compact annotations.

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Optional quiet depth; every Surface still retains a border.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs, and other overlapping content.

components.name: Subtle Button
components.description: The compact default for routine Storyden commands.
components.css: .ds-button-subtle { height:1.5rem; padding:0 .5rem; border:0; border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--colors-background-control-subtle, #e8e8e8); color:var(--colors-text-default, #202020); font:500 .75rem/1.125rem Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: The single decisive completion action in a workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-solid { height:1.5rem; padding:0 .5rem; border:0; border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--colors-accent-default); color:var(--colors-text-inverse); font:500 .75rem/1.125rem Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Surface
components.description: An independent content object. Every Surface and Card has a border.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding:.5rem; border:1px solid var(--colors-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius:.5rem; background:var(--colors-background-surface, #f9f9f9); color:var(--colors-text-default, #202020); }

components.name: Outlined Input
components.description: The default compact form control on the control background.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:1.5rem; padding:0 .5rem; border:1px solid var(--colors-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--colors-background-control, #fcfcfc); color:var(--colors-text-default, #202020); font:400 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Storyden is compact, calm community software. Neutral structural layers guide participation and curation while the community's content, identity, imagery, and configured accent remain primary.
keyCharacteristics: Community-native rather than generic corporate SaaS.
Compact and information dense without becoming crowded.
White-label foundations with selective semantic colour.
Storybook as directional product guidance, not only a prop catalogue.
WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard access, reduced motion, and stable responsive layouts.

rules.name: Meaning before appearance
rules.body: Choose the semantic role first: navigation, action, content object, supporting region, status, or overlay.

rules.name: Every Surface has a border
rules.body: All Cards are Surfaces and all Surfaces retain a border.default boundary; fill alone is not sufficient separation from Canvas.

rules.name: Composition before invention
rules.body: Consult Storybook and existing components before introducing a new visual language or local wrapper.

dos: Use semantic background, text, border, control, status, and accent tokens.
Use compact defaults and stable dimensions for repeated workflows.
Keep community content stronger than application chrome.
Use PageLayout and PageHeader as screen-level decisions.
Test interaction-heavy components from the outside.
donts: Do not invent ad-hoc structural backgrounds or text roles.
Do not nest visually identical Surfaces or use CardBox as a page wrapper.
Do not use accent colour when neutral selection communicates the state.
Do not duplicate the expensive navigation tree for responsive layouts.
Do not treat Storybook as a capability-only prop playground.
